form.statement: A repairable smartphone child Form may earn a declaration without pretending to be the ideal for every smartphone user.
form.scope: Imported from the 100-record register as a nonterminal SPLIT_REQUIRED research case. The ordinary use context, jurisdiction, and exact Form boundary remain part of adjudication.
exclusions: Sealed battery and display, short security support, proprietary lockout, unavailable modules, regional incompatibility, and a broad claim that ignores the user's actual Form.

subject.productionLineage: Exact model identity and production continuity remain to be verified.

evidenceGaps: Attach at least one primary technical or service source.
Attach independent evidence of longevity, failure behavior, or repair economics.
Record the strongest counter-case and the exact model or child Form boundary.

categorySearch.protocol: Research disposition imported from the canonical register. The case must record the candidate set, search coverage, and why the chosen Form is coherent before terminal review.
candidateSet: No exact subject named; Form or category split required

failureModes.remedy: Battery wear, display or port damage, discontinued modules, software support lapse, and regional network incompatibility.

maintenance: Replace battery, display, camera, port, or other supported modules; install supported software updates.
repairEconomics: Not yet established. Compare parts, labor, access, downtime, and rational replacement cost before terminal review.

counterCase.claim: A serious alternative or incompatible sub-Form may answer the same broad category differently.
counterCase.disposition: Counter-case not yet adjudicated; do not issue a terminal ruling until the strongest alternative is recorded and answered.

futureRequirement: Complete the evidence packet, five-gate findings, hard-disqualifier review, and human adjudication before promotion to DECLARED or EMPTY.
notes: Constitutional Batch 08 research disposition: broad parent split required; child declaration path identified. Do not publish Fairphone as the universal smartphone ideal. Seeded from the 100-record migration as a formal nonterminal case; this file does not issue a public ruling.
